value.main_text_excerpt:
Waterfalls & Helicopter Sightseeing Journey
Waterfalls and helicopter flight with a personalised video memory. Wheelchair friendly · cruise-passenger friendly.
Exclusive helicopter journeys over fjords, glaciers and waterfalls — bespoke private adventures with personalised video memories and dedicated hosting throughout.
Book one of our signature experiences — take a look:
Our most popular tour: a 30-minute private helicopter sightseeing flight over Lysefjord and Preikestolen, departing from Sola Airport (Stavanger). Wheelchair friendly · cruise-passenger friendly.
A fully private luxury journey from Bergen to Flåm, the UNESCO-listed Nærøyfjord and Gudvangen — dedicated local host, premium ground transport, scenic photography stops and personalized video memories. Cruise-passenger friendly · flexible itinerary.
A full-day private hiking adventure to Trolltunga with expert local guidance and seamless transport from Bergen. Scenic drive with a stop at Steinsdalsfossen waterfall, guided hike along the classic Trolltunga route, and a comfortable evening return.
A six-day private expedition to Norway's three most iconic summits — Trolltunga, Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock) and Kjeragbolten — with a dedicated host capturing personalised video memories of every hike. Luxury car transfers between regions through waterfalls, historical sites and dramatic fjord roads. Overnights at hand-picked high-standard partner hotels, with all hotel, trailhead and airport transfers included. One unforgettable journey. Three legendary summits. Zero logistics on your shoulders.
Two standardized full-day journeys with luxury pickup and drop-off at your cruise ship, hotel or airport. I — Månafossen & Byrkjedalstunet: drive to Dirdal, hike to the thundering Månafossen waterfall, explore the Magma UNESCO Geopark's collapsed-mountain landscape and lunch on Norwegian classics at Byrkjedalstunet. II — Sokndal, Helleren & Lysefjord: through historic Sokndal village down to the iconic Helleren houses under the cliff for personalised video memories, up via the Magma Geopark and Byrkjedalstunet to Lysebotn for the high-altitude Lysefjord viewpoint, descending the legendary Lysevegen to board the fjord cruise past Preikestolen and Kjeragbolten to Lauvvik.
Private helicopter flights from Bergen over the Hardangerfjord and Folgefonna glacier. Approximately 1.5 hours.
Fly across Norway's three most iconic fjord regions in one private helicopter journey — and return to Oslo the same day.
Private helicopter proposals and tailor-made wedding experiences at Norway’s most breathtaking fjords, cliffs and mountaintops.
Helicopter access to premium fjord hotels paired with curated Michelin-star dining packages in Stavanger, Bergen and beyond.
Professional personalised video memories included on selected experiences.
A personal host accompanies selected journeys for guidance and service.
Receive a professionally edited personalised video of your experience in Norway.
Send a quick request and our team replies personally within 24 hours with a tailored itinerary and exact pricing.
